Global identity and typed reference/Claim compatibility checks, immutable canonical index/link preservation and explicit Inquiry scope plans; no graph traversal or qualification.
Exact date/instant syntax, retained well-formed window inversion observations, and source-addressed supplied-field observations; no causal/grant/origin adjudication.
Exact-type bounded stack capture, alias-occurrence/cycle discipline, all declared shapes and local null/Gap/branch rules across selected and unselected records.
